column1: # JAVA-1 (F-203): no doc comment text can break or change the generated Java.
# Each row is one doc line of Probe.schema beside it, as written. The line must
# reach Probe.java as its own text (each \ read as the backslash it
# stands for gives the line back) and with no Unicode escape javac would
# translate (JLS 3.3). plain-doc is the control: a doc with no backslash,
# which every compiler keeps as it is.
